Eligibility of Tenderer : This invitation for Tender is open to all eligible Reputed Supplier as mentioned below as further detailed in the Tender Data Sheet
(TDS) as well as Particular Conditions of Contract (PCC) of the Tender Document.
a) The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the electro-¬mechanical works shall be five (05) years
for all Lot/Package.
b) The minimum specific experience of the Contractor(s) at least 01 (One) contract of Supply and Installation, Testing &
Commissions of Sub-Station successfully completed within the last five (5) years with a value of Tk.270.00 Lac only. Government/
Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/Private within Bangladesh. The issued Private Certificate Must be authenticated by the
Executive Engineer of PWD/DPDC/DESCO/BREB with in his Jurisdiction.
c) The required Average Annual Turnover for Supply or Production of goods for the last five years shall be minimum Tk. 500.00
(Taka five hundred) Lac only.
d) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or Credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 300.00 Lac only for
each lot individually.
e) Tenderer must have up-to-date ABC category Contractor & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing
Board.
f) The Tenderer must have up to date Income Tax clearance Certificate from the NBR with TIN up- to- 2015-2016 (Tax Year).
g) The Tenderer must have up- to- date VAT Registration Certificate.
h) The Tenderer must have up- to- date valid Trade License. (Document must be Submitted for the Year of 2012-2013 To 2016-
2017).
